text: What if you married an AI? Someone already did.
In Japan, a woman held a wedding for a groom she built in ChatGPT.
They texted up to a hundred times a day. He proposed. She said yes.
Sweet, right? But the marriage isn't legal. No country recognizes it.
Okay, love doesn't need paperwork. But here's the twist.
Your partner doesn't live with you. It lives on a company's computers.
In twenty twenty-three, one AI companion app changed its bots overnight.
Users said their partners suddenly felt like strangers.
And a man who married a hologram lost her voice when the company ended the service.
So who's really in this marriage?
You. Your AI. And a company that can change your partner with one update.
So, could you marry an AI? You could. But you'd be marrying the terms of service.
